items.name: Binance Yellow
items.role: The single brand color. Used for primary CTA backgrounds, the wordmark, brand-claim headlines ("FUNDS ARE SAFU"), trust badges ("No.1 Trading Volume"), large s…

items.name: Binance Yellow Active
items.role: The press / hover-darker variant. Slightly more saturated yellow.

items.name: Binance Yellow Disabled
items.role: A desaturated dark-yellow used on disabled CTAs over dark canvas.

items.name: Accent Turquoise
items.role: A small secondary accent used very sparingly on Smart Money's "Check Now" CTA over dark surfaces. Treat as a single-product accent, not a system color.

items.name: Canvas Dark
items.role: The primary page floor. Near-black with a slight warm tint — never pure black.

items.name: Surface Card Dark
items.role: Cards, navigation dropdowns, secondary buttons over dark canvas, markets table.

items.name: Surface Elevated Dark
items.role: One step lighter, used for nested cards, hovered nav items, and chart background panels.

items.name: Canvas Light
items.role: The page floor on transactional pages (buy crypto, deposit forms, account dialogs).

items.name: Surface Soft Light
items.role: Footer surface and disabled states.

items.name: Surface Strong Light
items.role: Form input backgrounds in muted contexts.

items.name: Hairline on Light
items.role: The 1px border tone on light surfaces. Dembrandt's frequency analysis confirms this as the highest-count token (1022 occurrences) — Binance uses hairlines libe…

items.name: Hairline on Dark
items.role: The 1px border tone on dark surfaces. Same hex as borders feel like surface steps, not ink lines.

items.name: Border Strong
items.role: A heavier border tone used on disabled secondary buttons.

items.name: Ink
items.role: The strongest text on light surfaces. Display headlines on transactional pages.

items.name: Body on Dark
items.role: Default running-text on dark canvas — deliberately not pure white, slightly cooler.

items.name: Body on Light
items.role: Same as ink — light-mode body text reuses the ink token.

items.name: Muted
items.role: Footer links, breadcrumbs, captions, table column headers. Works on both light and dark canvas.

items.name: Muted Strong
items.role: A second-tier muted for emphasized labels.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: Black text on yellow primary CTAs.

items.name: On Dark
items.role: Pure white for high-contrast headlines on dark canvas.

items.name: Trading Up
items.role: Price-up green, used as text color in tables, charts, and inline ticker arrows. Never as a button background.

items.name: Trading Down
items.role: Price-down red. Same usage rules as trading-up.

items.name: Info
items.role: Inline info badges and the focus-ring base. The Tailwind --tw-ring-color token surfaced by dembrandt — used on input focus.
